mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, type_code, type, level, institution_nature, devices, workers, sum_people, beds, province, city, county, country, unit_head, telephone, lon AS longitude, lat AS latitude, ST_AsText(point) AS geomText, -- 计算到中心点的距离（米） ST_Distance( ST_Transform(point, 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857) ) AS distance_meters FROM ( -- 子查询：将医院点和中心点转换为3857平面坐标（x/y米） SELECT *, -- 医院点的平面坐标（x1,y1） ST_X(ST_Transform(point, 3857)) AS x1, ST_Y(ST_Transform(point, 3857)) AS y1, -- 中心点的平面坐标（x0,y0） ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857)) AS x0, ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857)) AS y0 FROM xian_hospitals ) AS subquery WHERE -- 1. 点在外圈椭圆内（椭圆方程：(x-x0)²/a2² + (y-y0)²/b2² ≤ 1） POWER((x1 - x0), 2) / POWER(#{semiMajorAxis2}, 2) + POWER((y1 - y0), 2) / POWER(#{semiMinorAxis2}, 2) <= 1 -- 2. 点不在内圈椭圆内（椭圆方程：(x-x0)²/a1² + (y-y0)²/b1² > 1） AND POWER((x1 - x0), 2) / POWER(#{semiMajorAxis1}, 2) + POWER((y1 - y0), 2) / POWER(#{semiMinorAxis1}, 2) > 1 ORDER BY distance_meters
